notes.title: Linia Stripes on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers! 

Get ready for the release of [b]Linia Stripes[/b], the relaxing PC game that will be launching on Steam on May 2nd! 

Immerse yourself in the colorful world of Linia Stripes and identify stripes of progressive length on countless boards, all while enjoying the calming atmosphere and beautiful graphics. Plus, collect many wonderful patterns to create unique wallpapers that you can customize to your liking! Whether you're a puzzle game enthusiast or simply looking for a relaxing gaming experience, Linia Stripes is a must-play. 

So mark your calendars and get ready to relax with Linia Stripes – [b]coming to Steam on May 2nd[/b]!
